components.name: Twitch VC navigation button
components.description: Existing Twitch control with the shared production monogram; visual extract only.
components.html: <button class="ds-twitch" type="button" aria-label="Viewer Companion settings" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M1 6H6L10 19L15 6H20L12 26H7ZM24 6H31L29 11H25L21 21H27L25 26H19L16 22L21 9Z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-twitch { all: unset; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 6px; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .12s; } .ds-twitch:hover { background: #ffffff1a; } .ds-twitch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a970ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Kick VC navigation button
components.description: Existing Kick control with the same geometry, not a separate logo variant.
components.html: <button class="ds-kick" type="button" aria-label="Viewer Companion settings" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M1 6H6L10 19L15 6H20L12 26H7ZM24 6H31L29 11H25L21 21H27L25 26H19L16 22L21 9Z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-kick { all: unset; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 8px; background: #27272a; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .12s; } .ds-kick:hover { background: #3f3f46; } .ds-kick:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #53fc18; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary settings action
components.css: .ds-action { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #52525b; border-radius: 6px; background: #27272a; color: #fafafa; font: 500 13px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-action:hover { background: #3f3f46; border-color: #71717a; } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a78bfa; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-action:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: default; }

components.name: Primary settings action
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #9147ff; border-radius: 6px; background: #9147ff; color: #fafafa; font: 500 13px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #a970ff; border-color: #a970ff; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a78bfa; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: default; }

components.name: Exclusion textarea
components.css: .ds-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; color: #fafafa; font: 500 13px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-textarea { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 80px; resize: vertical; margin-top: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #52525b; border-radius: 6px; background: #09090b; color: #fafafa; caret-color: #a78bfa; font: 13px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-textarea::placeholder { color: #a1a1aa; opacity: 1; } .ds-textarea:hover { border-color: #71717a; } .ds-textarea:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a78bfa; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Settings card surface
components.description: Existing shell and header extract, not a reconstructed settings dialog.
components.css: .ds-card { box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 420px; max-width: calc(100vw - 16px); max-height: calc(100dvh - 16px); overflow: hidden; background: #18181b; color: #fafafa; border: 1px solid #3f3f46; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 12px 36px #0008; font: 13px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 16px 16px 4px 20px; } .ds-header strong { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.northStar: A compact companion, not a replacement.
narrative.overview: Viewer Companion (вьювер компаньен) uses an original, angular, solid monochrome VC monogram. The approved reference is 7TV's graphic economy, not its lettering or identity. This document captures a narrow rebrand and incumbent UI tokens, not a redesign or a new visual world. Existing layout, styles, behavior, and the product principles in `PRODUCT.md` remain unchanged.
keyCharacteristics: Forward-cut solid V and open C; compact, monochrome recognition.
Existing dark settings, system typography, and purple interaction accents.
Host-compatible injected controls rather than a standalone application shell.
dos: Do preserve the shared authored geometry and theme-specific asset treatments.
Do preserve incumbent UI layout, styles, behavior, host integration, and accessibility handling.
donts: Don't copy 7TV's mark or imply affiliation with external brands.
Don't expand this scoped rebrand into a redesign or invent palette ramps, motion, or a full visual world.
Don't rename compatibility identifiers, storage keys, or release artifacts solely to match visible branding.
